method: In 2022 Jose valued the four pieces of the 13 Chisel Creek property (the Shed 300,000, the Clubhouse 550,000, the developable land 2,237,600 - ten buildable lots at 100,000 plus 72.8 acres at 17,000 - and his own house 1,200,000) and turned those values into four percentage sets: all four together, without the Shed, without the house, and without either. The 'no Shed' set gives the personal share of the 1625 parcel (the house is 30.09%), so 69.91% of every township, county and Avon Grove school tax bill on that parcel, including the three interim bills for the new construction, and 69.91% of its insurance is business; the rest is Jose's personal expense. The business part of each tax is then divided between the developable land (80.27%) and the Clubhouse (19.73%) using the 'no shed/house' set, and the business part of the insurance is divided among the Shed, the land and the Clubhouse using the 'no house' set. The four ordinary rentals (176 Tulsk, 142 Maloney, 544 Liberty and the Shed's own tax parcel) keep 100% of their own tax and insurance bills. 533 Mystic, rented to the Bolmers from Feb 25 to Jul 31, counts only 157/365 = 43.01% of its bills as business. A fifth set weights every property (including the rentals) by market value times months in service, with 533 Mystic at 5 months; it splits the umbrella insurance premium (1,015.22) across all seven properties. Finally, the General-class expense totals for the year are reallocated to properties: landscaping, utilities, repairs, trash, snow removal and cleaning go to the land, the Clubhouse and the Shed by the 'no house' shares (rounding remainder to the Shed), while professional fees, bank fees, postage, software, supplies, travel, meals and donations go to all seven properties by the value-times-months shares (remainder to 533 Mystic). The sheet also carries the 2022 county assessment math for the parcel (assessment 968,990 after the 758,860 building addition, common level ratio 0.395, tax rate 3.41%) for reference only.

The personal (Our House) share of the 1625 parcel bills, 83,316.32 - 62,784.12 = 20,532.20 plus the non-rented part of 533 Mystic, is Jose's personal expense.

sets.label: All

totals.note: The sheet has no totals row for this block; column K holds 17 ERROR-check formulas (K75:K91) that all evaluate to empty.

reallocationOfGeneral.note: For each expense account, the year's General-class total (column C) is spread across the properties. Property-type costs 5204-5209 (landscaping, utilities, repairs, trash, snow, cleaning) use 'Just Chisel Creek' (Land / Clubhouse / Shed); each cell is ROUND(total x share, 2) and the rounding remainder goes to The Shed (G = C - D - F). Overhead accounts 5211-5224 use 'All' (value x months across all seven properties); remainder to 533 Mystic (J = C - sum of D:I). Bank fees 5212 are a -3.00 credit and are spread the same way.

coverage.note: Counted from the cached-value view of the sheet. The 17 check formulas in K75:K91 (=IF(SUM(..)<>total,"ERROR","")) all evaluate to an empty string and so are not non-empty cells.

billsPaidByProperty.label: Township Tax
billsPaidByProperty.note: Per-property bills paid from the bank (C37:H37; 533 Mystic and some others are entered as tax + a small fee, e.g. 99.15+2.23). 533 Mystic counts 43.0137% (rented Feb 25-Jul 31, H27); the rentals and the Shed count 100%; the 13 Chisel Creek parcel counts 69.9067% (1 - F21). Final row 66: 13 Chisel Creek business tax including the interim bill (H56+H57 = 1,665.41) is split 80.2698% to The Land (H66) / 19.7302% to The Clubhouse (I66) using pct_no_shed_house. The Our House remainder is personal.

billsPaidByProperty.label: Township Interim Tax
billsPaidByProperty.note: Interim (new-construction) township bill on the 1625 parcel only. Business share 69.9067% = 1,298.16 (H57); it has no final row of its own - it is folded into the Township Tax final row (H66:I66).

billsPaidByProperty.label: Chester County Tax
billsPaidByProperty.note: Same treatment as Township Tax. Final row 67 splits 13 Chisel Creek business county tax including the interim bill (H58+H59 = 3,036.93) between The Land and The Clubhouse with pct_no_shed_house.

billsPaidByProperty.label: Chester County Interim Tax
billsPaidByProperty.note: Interim county bill on the 1625 parcel only; business share 2,367.04 (H59) is folded into the Chester County Tax final row (H67:I67).

billsPaidByProperty.label: AG School Tax
billsPaidByProperty.note: Avon Grove School District tax. Same treatment as Township Tax. Final row 68 splits 13 Chisel Creek business school tax including the interim bill (H60+H61 = 31,350.25) between The Land and The Clubhouse with pct_no_shed_house.

billsPaidByProperty.label: AG School Interim Tax
billsPaidByProperty.note: Interim school bill on the 1625 parcel only; business share 8,713.26 (H61) is folded into the AG School Tax final row (H68:I68).

billsPaidByProperty.label: Insurance
billsPaidByProperty.note: Property insurance premiums entered as monthly premium x months (e.g. 89 x 12 for 533 Mystic, 74.33 x 8 for 176 Tulsk, 186.33 + 186.25 x 7 for 13 Chisel Creek); the Umbrella column (I43 = 136.16 + 125.58 x 7 = 1,015.22) is the umbrella policy, counted 100% business and allocated separately in row 70. The Shed has no premium of its own (G43 = 0, G53 = 0). Final row 69: the 13 Chisel Creek business premium H62 (1,041.67) is split Shed / Land / Clubhouse with pct_no_house (G18/G20/G19).

billsPaidByProperty.label: Umbrella
billsPaidByProperty.note: Umbrella policy premium (I43, 100% business per I53, business amount I62) spread over all seven properties with the market-value x months set (E25:E31). Its column is reported as 'Umbrella' in rows 36-63 and target UMBRELLA there because it is a bill, not a class.

specificBillsNote: specificBills are the five allocations the sheet actually performs (rows 66–70 for the 1625 parcel's business share and the umbrella premium). The bills as paid per property, the business-percentage table and the business-dollar table are kept verbatim under billsPaidByProperty and specificBillsTables.
